D.t: Josh Green leads by 36.5 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 167,237 votes; a one point swing is about 2,289 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +27.2 and D +45.8. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Honolulu, a projected net 108,981 votes; Hawaii, a projected net 28,089 votes; Maui, a projected net 23,199 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.

D.h: Where you run behind the 2024 map
D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Josh Green runs furthest behind in Kauai, Hawaii. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: White voters, 28% of voters, 50 to 50, where a 5 point gain is worth 1.39 points; Immigration voters, 9% of voters, 43 to 57, where a 5 point gain is worth 0.43 points.
The forecast's worst groups for Josh Green: Immigration voters 43 to 57, White voters 50 to 50, 2024 voters who skipped 2022 65 to 35. Cutting the loss here is often cheaper than winning new groups.

D.h: What the ballots so far say
D.t: The early vote has moved this forecast 1.2 points toward Josh Green. Bank it: chase the remaining mail ballots and low propensity voters who have not voted.
Money: Raised $313K against $3.7M for Josh Green.
